title: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet firmly planted on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and puff your chest out.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar by straightening your arms, then move it over your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest while keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle to your body.
Press the bar back up to the starting position, locking out your elbows.

title: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to an incline of 30-45 degrees.
Sit on the bench holding a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs.
Kick the dumbbells up to shoulder level and lean back onto the bench.
Press the dumbbells up directly over your upper chest until your arms are straight.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Press the weights back up to the starting position.

title: Peck Deck
steps: Adjust the seat height so the handles or arm pads sit at chest level.
Sit down and grasp the handles, or place your forearms on the pads with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Press your arms together in a hugging motion, squeezing your chest at the peak.
Pause and squeeze your pecs together at the center.
Slowly return to the starting position, allowing a stretch across your chest.

title: Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys on a cable crossover machine to the high position and attach D-handles.
Grab a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance with a slight forward lean.
With a slight bend in your elbows, pull the handles down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest hard as your hands cross or meet at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position, keeping tension on your chest throughout.

title: Incline Barbell Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your upper chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar under control to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up to the starting position, locking out your elbows at the top.

title: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Plant your feet firmly on the floor and brace your core.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

title: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest, squeezing your pecs at the top.
Keep the slight elbow bend fixed throughout the movement.

title: Incline Dumbbell Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest, squeezing your pecs at the top.

title: Chest Press Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your mid-chest.
Sit down and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause and squeeze your chest at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Barbell Declined Bench Press
steps: Secure your feet under the foot pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest.
Lower the bar under control to your lower chest.
Press the bar back up to the starting position, locking out your elbows.

title: Dumbbell Declined Bench Press
steps: Secure your feet under the foot pads of a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up above your lower chest until your arms are extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to chest level.
Keep your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

title: Push Ups
steps: Get into a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Your body should form a straight line from your head to your heels. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them tucked in at about a 45-degree angle to your sides.
Lower yourself until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.

title: Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, arms extended above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back to the starting position.
Keep your elbows tucked in throughout the movement.

title: Triceps Pressdown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley on a cable machine.
Grab the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and tuck your elbows into your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Slowly let the bar return to the starting position, keeping your elbows locked in place.

title: Cable Rope Pushdown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley on a cable machine.
Grab the rope with a neutral grip and stand with a slight forward lean, keeping your elbows tucked into your sides.
Push the rope down by straightening your arms, spreading the rope at the bottom.
Squeeze your triceps hard at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly allow the rope to return to the starting position, keeping your elbows locked in place.

title: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand or sit holding a single dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Keep your elbows close to your head and pointed forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms to press the dumbbell back overhead.

title: Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench and grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart or slightly closer.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar under control to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar back up by extending your arms, focusing on driving through your triceps.
Lock out your elbows at the top.

title: Kickback
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward at the hips, placing your free hand on a bench for support.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Extend your arm straight back by contracting your triceps, keeping your upper arm still.
Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position.

title: Reverse Grip Cable Triceps Extension with Barbell
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grab it with an underhand (supinated) grip.
Tuck your elbows into your sides and keep your upper arms stationary.
Push the bar down by extending your arms until they are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grab it with one hand, palm facing down.
Tuck your elbow into your side and keep your upper arm stationary.
Push the handle down by extending your arm until it's fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Extension with Supinated Grip
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grab it with an underhand (supinated) grip.
Tuck your elbow into your side and keep your upper arm stationary.
Push the handle down by extending your arm until it's fully straight, keeping the palm up.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your ears.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbows to press the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Keep your elbows tucked in throughout.

title: Seated Barbell French Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and hold an EZ bar overhead with arms extended.
Keep your elbows close to your head and pointed forward.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the starting position.

title: Bench Dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet out and lift your hips off the bench, supporting your weight on your hands.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until they reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pointed backward, not flared out.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

title: Parallel Dip Bar
steps: Grip the parallel bars and lift your body up until your arms are fully extended.
Lean your torso slightly forward and keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your core engaged and avoid swinging.
Push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.

title: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row (Single Arm)
steps: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support, holding a dumbbell in your free hand.
Keep your back flat and parallel to the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down under control, then repeat on the other side.

title: Wide-Grip Pulldown
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Secure your knees under the pads and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.

title: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at a low cable row machine with your feet on the platforms and knees slightly bent.
Grab the V-grip handle, sit up tall with a straight back, and pull your shoulders down and back.
Pull the handle towards your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak of the contraction.
Slowly extend your arms and let your shoulder blades stretch forward to return to the start.

title: Close-Grip Pulldown
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and attach a close-grip handle.
Grab the handle with a neutral or narrow overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position, getting a full stretch.

title: Barbell Row
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the barbell. Hinge at your hips and grip the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keep your back straight, nearly parallel to the floor, and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest/upper stomach area, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are fully extended.

title: Behind-Neck Pulldown
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Position the bar behind your head instead of in front.
Pull the bar down carefully to the base of your neck, keeping your torso upright.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom, avoiding excessive strain on your neck and shoulders.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.

title: Reverse-Grip Pulldown
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grab the bar with a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you pull.
Squeeze your lats and biceps at the bottom.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.

title: Rope Pulldown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley on a cable machine and grab an end in each hand.
Kneel or sit facing the machine with arms extended overhead.
Pull the rope down and out to the sides of your head, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: T-Bar Rows
steps: Straddle the bar on a T-bar row machine (or landmine setup) and grab the handles with a neutral grip.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and slight knee bend.
Pull the weight up toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the weight back down under control.

title: Barbell Bent Over Rows Supinated Grip
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the barbell and grip it with a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Hinge at your hips, keeping your back flat and nearly parallel to the floor.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest/upper stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are fully extended.

title: Pull Up
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended and your core engaged.
Initiate the movement by pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, driving your elbows down towards the floor.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top.
Lower yourself down under control to the starting position.

title: Behind the Neck Pull Up
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up until the bar reaches the back of your neck, keeping your torso upright.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top, being careful not to strain your neck.
Lower yourself back down under control.

title: Pull Up with a Supinated Grip
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width underhand (supinated) grip.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended and core engaged.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower yourself back down under control.

title: Straight Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grab it with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Stand facing the machine with a slight forward lean and arms extended.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position, feeling a stretch in your lats.

title: Dumbbell Bent Over Rows
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at your hips, keeping your back flat.
Let the dumbbells hang directly below your shoulders.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down under control.

title: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Lie perpendicular across a bench with only your upper back supported, holding a single dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell back and behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest to the starting position.
Keep your hips low throughout the movement.

title: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width overhand grip above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar back and behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull the bar back over your chest to the starting position.
Keep your core braced throughout.

title: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the barbell, feet hip-width apart.
Bend over and grab the bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Bend your knees until your shins touch the bar.
Lift your chest up and straighten your lower back.
Take a deep breath, brace your core, and stand up with the weight by pushing the floor away with your legs.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the movement. Return the weight to the floor by pushing your hips back.

title: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward, and the barbell over your mid-foot.
Grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Bend your knees and hips to lower into position, keeping your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your heels and push the floor away to stand up, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lock out your hips at the top, then reverse the motion to lower the bar back down.

title: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand inside a trap bar with feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and hips to grab the handles, keeping your chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand up, keeping the bar close to your body.
Lock out your hips and knees at the top.
Lower the bar back down under control by hinging at the hips and bending your knees.

title: Dumbbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips, lowering the dumbbells along your legs while pushing your hips back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

title: Barbell Shrug
steps: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Keep your arms straight and core braced.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible.
Squeeze your traps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.

title: Dumbbell Shrugs
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
Keep your arms straight and core braced.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible.
Squeeze your traps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.

title: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall with your chest up and core braced, holding a barbell with a shoulder-width, underhand grip.
Keeping your elbows tucked in close to your torso, curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps hard at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell under control back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Avoid using momentum by swinging your torso; keep your body still.

title: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder while keeping the other arm still.
Squeeze your bicep at the top, then lower under control.
Repeat on the opposite arm, alternating sides.

title: Rope Cable Curl
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley on a cable machine.
Grab the ends of the rope with a neutral grip and stand tall, elbows tucked in.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders, rotating your wrists slightly outward at the top.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.

title: EZ Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding an EZ curl bar with an underhand grip on the angled portions.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar back down under control, fully extending your arms.
Avoid swinging your torso to generate momentum.

title: EZ Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting flat on the pad.
Grab an EZ curl bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar back down slowly until your arms are almost fully extended.
Keep your upper arms pressed against the pad throughout.

title: Hammer Curl
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
Keep your palms facing your body (neutral grip) throughout the movement.
Keeping your elbows tucked in, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps and forearms at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

title: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench set to about 45-60 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms stationary against the bench.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows still.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down, feeling a deep stretch at the bottom.

title: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your legs spread and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm still.
Squeeze your bicep hard at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down, then repeat on the other side.

title: Single-Arm Low Pulley Cable Curl
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and grab it with an underhand grip.
Stand facing away from the machine with your elbow tucked into your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your bicep at the top.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Straight Bar Low Pulley Cable Curl
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grab it with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Stand facing the machine with your elbows tucked into your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.

title: Standing High Pulley Cable Curl
steps: Stand between two high pulleys with a handle attached to each.
Grab a handle in each hand with your arms extended out to the sides.
Curl your hands toward your head, keeping your upper arms in place.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Seated Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding a barbell with an underhand grip, wrists hanging off your knees.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl the bar upward by flexing your wrists as high as possible.
Squeeze your forearms at the top.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.

title: Seated Barbell Wrist Extension
steps: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, wrists hanging off your knees.
Lower the bar down as far as comfortable.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar upward as high as possible.
Squeeze your forearms at the top.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.

title: Reverse Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight.
Squeeze your forearms and biceps at the top.
Lower the bar back down under control, fully extending your arms.

title: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and curl your shoulders up off the floor toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back down under control.

title: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hands behind your head.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Squeeze your obliques at the top.
Lower back down and repeat on the other side.

title: Crunch Machine
steps: Sit on the ab crunch machine and adjust the seat so the pads rest against your upper chest or shoulders.
Grip the handles and engage your core.
Crunch forward by contracting your abs, pulling the pads down toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Rope Ab Pulldown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine, holding an end of the rope in each hand near your head.
Engage your core and curl your torso downward, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom of the movement.
Keep your hips stationary throughout.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Plank
steps: Start on the floor resting on your forearms and knees.
Step your feet back one at a time to come into a forearm plank position.
Make sure your elbows are directly beneath your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Do not let your hips sag or hike up.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core as if you are about to be punched in the stomach.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, breathing evenly.

title: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and core engaged.
Keeping your legs straight (or knees bent for an easier variation), raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift until your legs are at least parallel to the floor, or higher for a full range.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Slowly lower your legs back down under control, avoiding swinging.

title: Bent Knee Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lifted, shins parallel to the floor.
Place your hands by your sides or under your lower back for support.
Engage your core and curl your hips up off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your lower abs at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down under control.

title: Long Arm Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Extend your arms straight overhead, keeping them close to your ears.
Engage your core and curl your shoulders up off the floor, reaching your arms toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back down under control.

title: Plank Get Ups
steps: Start in a forearm plank position with your body in a straight line.
Push up onto one hand, then the other, coming into a high plank.
Lower back down onto one forearm, then the other, returning to a forearm plank.
Keep your hips stable and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate the leading arm with each repetition.

title: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your back straight.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

title: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing inwards.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows and keep your core tight.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Lead with your elbows slightly rather than your wrists to better target the lateral deltoid.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

title: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core braced.
Raise the dumbbells up in front of you until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

title: High Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set two pulleys to a high position and grab the left handle with your right hand and the right handle with your left hand, crossing the cables.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc, squeezing your rear delts and shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the peak of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Set a bench upright under the bar of a Smith machine and sit down, gripping the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it at shoulder height.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the bar back down to shoulder height under control.

title: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, resting against your thighs.
Keeping the bar close to your body, pull it straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Raise your elbows above your wrists at the top of the movement.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.

title: Bent-Over Lateral Raise
steps: Hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand hanging below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down under control.

title: Cable One-Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand sideways to the machine, grabbing the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow and your core braced.
Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Dumbbell Push Press
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Slightly bend your knees and dip down, then explosively drive up through your legs.
Use the momentum to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lock out your elbows at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder height under control.

title: Barbell Push Press
steps: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, feet shoulder-width apart.
Slightly bend your knees and dip down, then explosively drive up through your legs.
Use the momentum to press the bar overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lock out your elbows at the top.
Lower the bar back down to shoulder height under control.

title: Single-Arm Cable Front Raise
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the handle with one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm straight up in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand, shoulder-width grip in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core braced.
Raise the bar up in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.

title: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your back against the bench.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the bar back down to shoulder height under control.

title: Seated Behind the Neck Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell behind your neck with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the bar back down behind your neck under control, avoiding excessive strain.

title: Standing Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the bar back down to shoulder height under control.

title: Standing Behind the Neck Barbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell behind your neck with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the bar back down behind your neck under control, avoiding excessive strain.

title: Alternate Dumbbell Front Raise Neutral Grip
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body (neutral grip).
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core braced.
Raise one dumbbell up in front of you until it reaches shoulder height while keeping the other arm still.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower and repeat on the opposite arm, alternating sides.

title: One-Arm Low-Pulley Front Raise Neutral Grip
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm straight up in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Two-Handed Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding one end of a single dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core braced.
Raise the dumbbell up in front of you until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.

title: Squat
steps: Rest the barbell securely on your upper back/shoulders (not your neck).
Step back from the rack with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly out.
Take a deep breath, brace your core, and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting in a chair, keeping your weight over your mid-foot.
Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor (or deeper if mobility allows).
Drive through your whole foot to push back up to the starting position.

title: Leg Press
steps: Sit on the leg press machine and place your feet on the sled shoulder-width apart.
Ensure your back and head are flat against the backrest.
Unrack the sled and slowly bend your knees to lower the weight towards your chest.
Lower until your knees are at a 90-degree angle, making sure your lower back doesn't lift off the pad.
Push the weight back up through your heels and mid-foot until your legs are straight but not locked out.

title: Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the leg extension machine with the pad resting on top of your lower shins.
Adjust the pad and back support so your knees align with the machine's pivot point.
Extend your legs by straightening your knees until your legs are fully extended.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Slowly lower the weight back down under control.

title: Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees, with your front knee over your ankle.
Keep your chest up and core engaged.
Push off your front foot to return to the starting position, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad resting just above your heels.
Hold the handles lightly for stability.
Curl your legs up as far as possible by contracting your hamstrings.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.

title: Hack Squat
steps: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your shoulders and back against the pads and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees to lower the weight until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and mid-foot to return to the starting position.

title: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit on the leg curl machine with the pad resting against the back of your lower legs and your legs extended.
Adjust the thigh pad to secure your legs.
Curl your legs down and back by bending your knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control.

title: Single Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the leg extension machine with the pad resting on top of one lower shin.
Adjust the pad so your knee aligns with the machine's pivot point.
Extend that leg by straightening your knee until it is fully extended.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Slowly lower the weight back down, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Front Squat
steps: Rest the barbell across the front of your shoulders, crossing your arms or using a clean grip to hold it in place.
Step back from the rack with feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows up and chest tall as you push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down.
Squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position, keeping your torso upright.

title: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight with only a slight bend.
Hinge at your hips, lowering the dumbbells along your legs while pushing your hips back.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

title: Barbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees nearly straight with only a slight bend.
Hinge at your hips, lowering the bar along your legs while pushing your hips back.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

title: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a single dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands, cupping the top end.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
Squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

title: Knee Tuck Jumps
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms back to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump up, driving your knees toward your chest as high as possible.
Extend your legs to land softly, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat immediately for the next repetition.

title: Burpees
steps: Start standing, then squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a high plank position.
Perform a push-up (optional), then jump your feet back up to your hands.
Explosively jump up into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and repeat.

title: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting into a chair, keeping your chest up.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Keep your weight over your mid-foot throughout.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

title: 1.5 Rep Bodyweight Squats
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Rise halfway up, then lower back down to the bottom position.
From the bottom, drive all the way back up to standing, completing one and a half repetitions.
Keep your chest up and core braced throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

title: Medicine Ball Squat
steps: Hold a medicine ball at chest height with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your chest up.
Squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

title: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand a couple of feet in front of a bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand a couple of feet in front of a bench with the top of one foot resting on it behind you.
Keep your torso upright and hands on your hips or held together at your chest.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Mini-Band Air Squat
steps: Place a mini resistance band around your legs, just above your knees.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, pressing outward against the band to keep tension.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position, maintaining outward pressure on the band.

title: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Explosively jump straight up, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly back into the squat position to absorb the impact.
Immediately repeat for the next repetition.

title: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet out in front of you.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent at about 90 degrees, thighs parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall and core engaged.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Slide back up the wall to finish.

title: Medicine Ball Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs with both hands.
Keep your back straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips, lowering the ball toward the floor while pushing your hips back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

title: Single Leg Bodyweight Deadlift
steps: Stand tall on one leg with a slight bend in your knee.
Hinge at your hips, extending your free leg straight back behind you for balance.
Lower your torso toward the floor until it's roughly parallel, reaching your arms forward or down.
Keep your standing leg stable and hips square.
Drive through your standing leg to return to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward, and a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your heels and stand up, keeping the kettlebell close to your body.
Lower the kettlebell back down under control by hinging at the hips.

title: Good Morning
steps: Stand with a barbell resting across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your core braced.
Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso forward while keeping your back flat.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the standing position.

title: Bodyweight Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your arms at your sides for stability.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

title: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, extending the other leg straight out.
Place your arms at your sides for stability.
Drive through your planted heel and lift your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Hold briefly at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down, then repeat on the other side.

title: Banded Glute Bridge
steps: Place a mini resistance band around your legs, just above your knees.
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Press your knees outward against the band as you drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down, maintaining tension on the band.

title: Duck Walk
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down into a low, deep squat position.
Keep your chest up and hands clasped in front of you for balance.
While staying low in the squat, step forward with one foot, then the other, walking forward.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes throughout.
Continue for the desired distance or number of steps.

title: Bird Dog
steps: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Engage your core to keep your spine neutral.
Extend one arm straight forward while simultaneously extending the opposite leg straight back.
Hold briefly, keeping your hips and shoulders square to the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

title: Groiners
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders.
Step one foot forward outside of the same-side hand, coming into a deep lunge.
Rotate your torso and reach the opposite arm toward the ceiling.
Return your hand to the floor and step your foot back to plank.
Repeat on the other side, alternating continuously.

title: Fire Hydrants
steps: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso.
Slowly lower your leg back down, then repeat on the same side or switch.

title: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and position the Smith machine bar across your hips (use a pad for comfort).
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent.
Unrack the bar and drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips back down under control.

title: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and roll a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips back down under control.

title: Band Seated Hip Abduction
steps: Sit on a bench with a mini resistance band placed around your thighs, just above your knees.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and back straight.
Press your knees outward against the band as far as comfortable.
Squeeze your outer hips at the peak of the movement.
Slowly bring your knees back together under control.

title: Seated Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit on the hip abduction machine with your legs against the pads and adjust the range of motion setting.
Keep your back against the seat and core engaged.
Push your legs outward against the pads as far as comfortable.
Squeeze your outer hips at the peak of the movement.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position under control.

title: Standing Cable Abduction
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and secure it around one ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine, holding onto it for balance.
Keep your working leg straight and raise it out to the side away from the machine.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Bodyweight Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees bent out to the sides, like a frog position.
Place your arms at your sides for stability.
Drive through the outer edges of your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

title: Smith Machine Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back under a Smith machine bar with the soles of your feet together and knees bent out to the sides.
Position the bar across your hips (use a pad for comfort).
Drive through the outer edges of your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down under control.

title: Banded Clams
steps: Lie on your side with a mini resistance band around your thighs, knees bent and stacked, hips stacked.
Keep your feet together and engage your core.
Rotate your top knee upward, opening it like a clam, while keeping your feet together.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top.
Slowly lower your knee back down, then repeat before switching sides.

title: Side Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and body in a straight line.
Rest your head on your lower arm or prop it up with your hand.
Raise your top leg straight up as high as comfortable, keeping it in line with your body.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top.
Slowly lower your leg back down, then repeat before switching sides.

title: Glute Ham Raise
steps: Position yourself in the glute ham developer with your ankles secured under the pads and knees on the pad.
Start with your body straight, from knees to shoulders.
Lower your torso toward the floor by bending at the knees, controlling the descent with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Curl your body back up to the starting position by contracting your hamstrings and glutes.

title: Dumbbell Step Up
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a bench or sturdy step platform.
Place one foot fully on the platform.
Push through that foot to step up, bringing your other foot to meet it on top.
Step back down with control, leading with the same foot.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg or completing all reps on one side first.

title: Lateral Mini-Band Walk
steps: Place a mini resistance band around your legs, just above or below your knees.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and bend your knees slightly into a quarter-squat position.
Step sideways with one foot, then follow with the other, maintaining tension on the band.
Keep your hips level and core engaged throughout.
Continue stepping in one direction, then reverse.

title: Standing Knee Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and lift one knee up toward your chest as high as comfortable.
Hold briefly at the top, keeping your balance.
Lower your leg back down under control.
Repeat on the same side or alternate legs.

title: Kettlebell Swings
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Hinge at your hips, letting the kettlebell swing back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell up to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed and let the momentum come from your hips, not your arms.
Let the kettlebell swing back down and repeat the movement continuously.

title: Standing Cable Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and secure it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine, holding on for balance, with a slight forward lean.
Keeping your leg mostly straight, kick your working leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.

title: Donkey Kicks
steps: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, kick one leg up and back toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement without arching your lower back.
Slowly lower your knee back down toward the floor.
Repeat on the same side, or complete all reps before switching.

title: Side Lying Hip Raise
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and propped up on your forearm.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping your feet together.
Lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your obliques and outer hip at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back down, then repeat before switching sides.

title: Squat Sit to Reach
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
From the bottom of the squat, reach both arms forward and rotate your torso slightly to one side.
Return your arms and torso to center, then drive through your feet to stand back up.
Alternate the reaching side with each repetition.

title: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit at the seated calf raise machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform, with the pads resting on your lower thighs.
Lower your heels as far as possible to stretch your calves.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Squeeze your calves at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back down under control.

title: Standing Calf Raise
steps: Position your shoulders under the pads of a standing calf raise machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Stand tall, with a slight bend in your knees, letting your heels hang off the edge.
Lower your heels as far as possible to stretch the calves.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Squeeze your calves at the top, then slowly lower back down.

title: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Position a flat bench in the center of the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your mid-chest when you lie down.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor, and shoulder blades pulled together.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and rotate your wrists to unhook it from the safeties.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest, keeping your elbows at roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight, then re-hook the bar when your set is finished.

title: Incline Chest Press Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest, then sit with your back flat against the pad.
Plant your feet on the floor and grip the handles with your wrists straight.
Press the handles forward and slightly upward until your arms are almost fully extended.
Slowly bring the handles back until you feel a stretch across your chest, keeping your shoulders down and back.

title: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys to the lowest position and attach a single handle to each.
Stand in the middle with a staggered stance, a slight forward lean, and a handle in each hand at your sides.
With a soft bend in your elbows, sweep your hands up and together until they meet in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment at the top without letting your shoulders roll forward.
Lower slowly along the same arc until you feel a stretch across your chest.

title: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your upper arms at roughly 45 degrees from your torso with your elbows resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the weights slowly until the backs of your upper arms lightly touch the floor, then press again without bouncing.

title: Decline Push Up
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Brace your abs and glutes so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows at roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the floor away to return to the start without letting your hips sag.
Elevating the feet shifts more of the load onto the upper chest and shoulders, so lower the bench height to make it easier.

title: Chest Dip
steps: Grip the parallel bars and press up until your arms are straight, with your shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
Lean your torso forward about 30 degrees and bend your knees, crossing your ankles behind you.
Lower your body slowly while your elbows flare slightly, until you feel a deep stretch in your chest and your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the start while keeping the forward lean. Stop short of the full depth if your shoulders feel pinched.

title: Resistance Band Chest Press
steps: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height, or wrap it around your upper back, and hold one end in each hand.
Stand in a staggered stance with your elbows bent and your hands beside your chest.
Press your hands forward until your arms are straight, keeping your core braced and your back from arching.
Return slowly to the start, keeping tension in the band the whole time.

title: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to an incline of 30-45 degrees and lie face down with your chest against the pad.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down with your palms facing each other and your feet planted on the floor.
Pull your elbows up and back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the weights slowly until your arms are fully extended, keeping your chest on the pad throughout.

title: Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the barbell on the floor over the middle of your feet.
Hinge forward and grip the bar just outside your legs, with a flat back and your torso close to parallel to the floor.
Brace your core and pull the bar explosively to your lower chest or upper abdomen.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and reset before each rep, keeping your torso angle the same.

title: Inverted Row
steps: Set the Smith machine bar (or a barbell in a power rack) at about waist height.
Lie under the bar and grip it with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
With your heels on the floor and your body in a straight line, pull your chest up to the bar by driving your elbows back.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower yourself until your arms are fully extended. Bend your knees to make it easier.

title: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and sit or kneel facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand, extend your arm overhead, and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribcage until the handle is near shoulder level.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom, then return slowly to the full stretch without letting your shoulder shrug up.

title: Seated Row Machine
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can reach the handles with your arms straight and your chest against the pad.
Grasp the handles and sit tall with your shoulders down.
Pull your elbows back until your hands are beside your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and let your shoulder blades spread apart while keeping your chest on the pad.

title: Assisted Pull Up Machine
steps: Select the assistance weight. A heavier setting makes the exercise easier.
Step onto the knee pad and grip the handles with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down until your chin clears the handles.
Lower yourself slowly back to straight arms with your core braced.

title: Superman
steps: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Squeeze your lower back and glutes to lift your arms, chest, and legs a few inches off the floor at the same time.
Hold for one to two seconds, then lower slowly.

title: Back Extension
steps: Adjust the pad so it sits just below your hip bones and hook your heels under the foot rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Hinge at the hips to lower your torso until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Raise your torso back up until your body is in a straight line. Do not arch past neutral at the top.

title: Rack Pull
steps: Set the safety pins so the bar rests just below knee height.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over your mid-foot, then hinge and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat, chest up, and lats tight as you drive through your feet.
Extend your hips and knees to pull the bar up your thighs to a full lockout, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar under control back to the pins.

title: Resistance Band Row
steps: Anchor a resistance band at chest height, or sit on the floor with the band looped around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended and your torso tall.
Pull the handles toward your ribs by driving your elbows straight back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then return slowly to the start.

title: Arnold Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells at chest height with your palms facing you.
Press the dumbbells up while rotating your palms to face forward as your arms extend overhead.
Lower the dumbbells while rotating your palms back toward you until they return to chest height.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching your lower back.

title: Shoulder Press Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower the handles slowly back to shoulder height.

title: Face Pull
steps: Set a cable pulley at about upper-chest to face height and attach a rope.
Grab the rope with your thumbs toward you and step back until your arms are extended and the cable is under tension.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart beside your ears with your elbows high.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back for a moment, then return slowly.

title: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it and adjust the handles so your arms start in front of you at shoulder height.
Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms back and out until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your rear delts, then return slowly without letting the weight stack rest.

title: Lateral Raise Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so your shoulder joints line up with the machine's pivot points.
Sit tall with the pads resting against your outer arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.

title: Pike Push Up
steps: Start in an inverted V with your hips high, your hands about shoulder-width apart, and your legs nearly straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight, keeping your hips high throughout.
To make it harder, elevate your feet on a bench.

title: Handstand Push Up
steps: Place your hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart and 15-20 cm from a wall, with a folded mat on the floor under your head.
Kick up into a handstand facing the wall, with your core and glutes tight and your body in a straight line.
Lower your head slowly toward the mat by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight. Build up to this with pike push ups first, and step down from the wall if you lose control.

title: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and hold one end in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your chest up.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly and avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

title: Band Pull Apart
steps: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height with your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Stop when your arms are in line with your shoulders and the band touches your chest.
Return slowly to the start while keeping your ribs down.

title: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Set the bar at about thigh height and grip it with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with your arms straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows or rolling your shoulders.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

title: Farmer's Walk
steps: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand with a flat back, then stand tall with your shoulders pulled back.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down and your chest up.
Walk with short, controlled steps for the set distance or time.
Keep your shoulders level and do not lean to either side, then set the dumbbells down with a flat back.

title: Cable Shrug
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand close to the machine.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart, and stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

title: Incline Bench Y Raise
steps: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees and lie face down with your chest supported and a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with your thumbs pointing up.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape at about ear level, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze the muscles between your shoulder blades, then lower slowly. Use light weights.

title: Preacher Curl Machine
steps: Adjust the seat so your armpits rest on top of the pad, then grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight, without letting the weight bounce.

title: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with the back of one upper arm resting on the pad, holding a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the dumbbell up until your forearm is close to vertical, keeping your elbow on the pad.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is almost fully extended, then switch arms after your reps.

title: Spider Curl
steps: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest against the pad.
Let your arms hang straight down, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full extension.

title: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine, holding the handle with your arm extended behind your torso.
Step forward until the cable is under tension and lean forward slightly.
Curl your hand toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow behind or beside your torso.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to a full stretch. Switch arms after your reps.

title: Zottman Curl
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to shoulder height with your elbows pinned to your sides.
At the top, rotate your wrists so your palms face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with your palms down, then rotate your palms back up at the bottom and repeat.

title: Resistance Band Curl
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and hold one end in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows by your sides and your chest up.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

title: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip and the bar resting against your thighs.
Keep the bar in contact with your body as you curl, pulling your elbows back so the bar drags up your torso.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the bar along the same path and avoid swinging your torso.

title: Diamond Push Up
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands together under your chest, your thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands with your elbows tracking back close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight. Drop to your knees to make it easier.

title: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine, holding the rope behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing forward.
Step forward into a staggered stance so the cable is under tension.
Extend your arms forward and up until they are straight, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze your triceps, then return slowly and avoid arching your lower back.

title: Triceps Dip Machine
steps: Adjust the seat height and select your weight, then sit upright with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, keeping your shoulders down.

title: JM Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder-width, then hold it over your upper chest with your arms straight. Use a spotter and moderate weight.
Lower the bar in a short arc toward your upper chest and chin line by bending your elbows, keeping them tucked and pointing forward.
Stop with the bar a few inches above your chest.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back to the start.

title: Resistance Band Triceps Pushdown
steps: Anchor a resistance band to a high point, such as the top of a door or a pull-up bar, and face the anchor holding both ends.
Pin your elbows to your sides with your hands at chest height.
Push your hands down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then return slowly without letting your elbows drift forward.

title: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell with your palm facing up and your forearm resting on your thigh, with your wrist hanging past your knee.
Lower the dumbbell by letting your wrist extend downward.
Curl the dumbbell back up by flexing your wrist.
Keep your forearm still and move slowly in both directions, then switch arms.

title: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
steps: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing down and your forearm resting on your thigh, with your wrist hanging past your knee.
Lower the dumbbell by letting your wrist bend downward.
Lift the dumbbell back up by extending your wrist.
Keep your forearm still and use a light weight, then switch arms.

title: Dead Hang
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Step off or jump up so you hang with your arms straight.
Keep your shoulders slightly pulled down rather than shrugged up toward your ears.
Hold for as long as you can with good form, then step down carefully.

title: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the bar at upper-chest height and step under it so it rests across your upper back, with your feet slightly in front of the bar.
Rotate your wrists to unhook the bar and brace your core.
Bend your hips and knees to lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive through your mid-foot to stand back up, then re-hook the bar when finished.

title: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push through your front heel and bring your back foot forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and alternate legs for the set distance.

title: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees, with your back knee just above the floor.
Keep your front shin roughly vertical and your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand about two feet in front of a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand, and rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.

title: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a sturdy support for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and lean your torso back.
Push your knees forward and down while keeping a straight line from your knees to your shoulders, going only as low as feels comfortable.
Extend your knees to return to standing. This puts high stress on the knees, so build range of motion gradually.

title: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front of you and your arms reaching forward.
Sit your hips back and down, keeping your standing heel on the floor.
Lower as far as you can control, then drive through your standing foot to rise.
Hold a support or squat to a box until you have the strength and mobility for the full range.

title: Single-Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the center of the platform, with the other foot resting on the floor or the side.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until your knee is bent to about 90 degrees, keeping your hips on the seat.
Press the platform back up without locking your knee.
Complete your reps, then switch legs. Use a lighter weight than for the two-leg press.

title: Box Jump
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box at a comfortable distance with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip into a quarter squat, then explode upward, swinging your arms forward.
Land softly on the box with both feet fully on it and your knees bent.
Stand up tall, then step down one foot at a time and reset for the next rep.

title: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Set a barbell on a rack at upper-chest height, step under it, and rest it across your upper back as you would for a squat.
Unrack the bar and take a few steps back, standing tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then alternate legs. Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position.

title: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Kneel on a padded surface and anchor your ankles securely, with a partner or under a sturdy bar.
Keep your body in a straight line from your knees to your head, with your arms in front of you.
Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can, resisting with your hamstrings.
When you can no longer control the lowering, catch yourself with your hands, then push off the floor to return to the start.

title: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs and shift your weight onto one leg with a soft knee bend.
Hinge at your hips, extending the other leg straight behind you as your torso lowers toward parallel.
Keep your back flat and the dumbbells close to your standing leg.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing, then switch legs after your reps.

title: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine, reaching between your legs to hold the rope.
Walk forward until the cable is under tension, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back so the rope passes between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall, keeping your arms straight.

title: Sliding Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with your heels on sliding discs (or towels), and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge position.
Slide your heels away from you to straighten your legs while keeping your hips raised.
Pull your heels back toward you by bending your knees, keeping your hips high, then lower your hips between reps if needed.

title: Resistance Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on one end of a resistance band with your feet hip-width apart, and loop the other end over the back of your neck and shoulders.
Keep a soft bend in your knees and your chest up.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

title: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Set the bar at about thigh height and grip it with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with the bar against your thighs and a soft bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, then re-hook the bar when finished.

title: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench, your knees bent, and a dumbbell resting across your hips.
Hold the dumbbell in place and plant your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line, with your chin tucked and your ribs down.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.

title: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the side of a bench and one foot flat on the floor, with the other leg extended or held up.
Drive through the heel of your working foot to lift your hips until your torso and thigh are in line.
Keep your hips level and your ribs down, and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower under control, then switch legs after your reps.

title: Hip Thrust Machine
steps: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips and your upper back rests on the support.
Place your feet flat on the platform, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.

title: Glute Kickback Machine
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so your working hip lines up with the pivot of the machine, and hold the handles.
Place your working foot on the platform or pad.
Press your leg back and slightly up by extending your hip until it is in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the end of the movement, then return slowly without arching your lower back.

title: Hip Adduction Machine
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and place your legs against the pads, with the starting range set to a comfortable stretch.
Hold the handles and keep your torso still.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet.
Return slowly to the starting position without letting the weight stack rest.

title: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes turned out 30-45 degrees.
