Hold one dumbbell vertically with both hands so it hangs between your legs.
Squat down with your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes at the top.

title: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, or hold one at your chest.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg, as if curtsying.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your foot.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then repeat on the other leg.

title: Cossack Squat
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes turned slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and sitting back and down, while the other leg stays straight with your toes up.
Keep your chest up and your working heel on the floor, going only as low as your mobility allows.
Drive through your working foot to return to the center, then switch sides.

title: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place a sturdy plate or step under the bar and stand with the balls of your feet on it and your heels hanging off.
Set the bar across your upper back and unhook it.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels slowly for a full stretch.

title: Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the edge of a step on one foot, holding a wall or rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

title: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit in the leg press and place the balls of your feet low on the platform with your heels hanging off.
Extend your legs without locking your knees and release the safeties.
Press the platform away by pointing your toes as far as you can.
Pause, then let your heels drop slowly for a full stretch.

title: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand on the edge of a step or plate with the balls of your feet on it, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Let your heels drop below the step for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

title: Tibialis Raise
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about 30-45 cm in front of you, with your legs straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly back to the floor.

title: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel on the floor beneath your shoulders.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll the wheel forward, extending your arms only as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees using your abs and lats. Shorten the range if your lower back arches.

title: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with your arms extended toward the ceiling and your hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and keep it there.
Lower your opposite arm and leg toward the floor at the same time without letting your back arch.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.

title: Pallof Press
steps: Set a cable pulley at chest height with a single handle and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and step away until the cable pulls you toward the machine.
Press the handle straight out in front of you while resisting any twisting of your torso.
Hold for one to two seconds, bring the handle back to your chest, and switch sides after your reps.

title: Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a cable pulley high and stand side-on to the machine with your feet wider than shoulder-width.
Grip the handle with both hands above your outer shoulder.
Pull the handle diagonally down across your body toward your opposite hip, rotating your torso and pivoting your back foot.
Return slowly to the start under control, then switch sides after your reps.

title: Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back until your torso and thighs form a V, keeping your chest up.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest and lift your heels slightly to make it harder.
Rotate your torso to one side, tapping your hands on the floor beside your hip.
Rotate to the other side and keep alternating with a straight back.

title: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head and your knees bent and lifted.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down and avoid pulling on your neck.

title: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder and your legs stacked, or with one foot in front of the other.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position without letting your hips sag.
Switch sides after your hold.

title: Hollow Body Hold
steps: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Bend your knees to make it easier, and stop if your lower back lifts off the floor.

title: Toes to Bar
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your shoulders pulled down.
Brace your core and tilt your pelvis slightly upward.
Raise your legs, with a slight knee bend if needed, until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs under control without swinging. Start with hanging leg raises if this is too difficult.

title: Decline Sit-Up
steps: Secure your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with your arms crossed over your chest.
Curl your torso up, bringing your chest toward your thighs.
Lower slowly back down until your shoulder blades touch the bench.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

title: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, with your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways at your waist, lowering the dumbbell down your thigh.
Contract your obliques to return to upright.
Avoid leaning forward or backward, and switch sides after your reps.

title: Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in your right hand, with your arm pressed straight up. Bend your right knee with your foot flat on the floor, and extend your left arm and leg out to your side at about 45 degrees.
Keeping your eyes on the kettlebell, roll up onto your left elbow, then onto your left hand.
Lift your hips into a bridge, then sweep your left leg back and under you into a kneeling position.
Move your torso upright into a half-kneeling position, then stand up.
Reverse each step to lower yourself back to the floor, keeping your arm locked out and the kettlebell vertical throughout. Switch sides after your reps.

title: Kettlebell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with the kettlebell on the floor between your feet, then hinge and grab the handle with one hand.
Drive your hips forward to pull the kettlebell up close to your body, rotating your hand around it into the rack position with your forearm vertical and your elbow tucked.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the rack position, then back down to the floor under control, and switch sides after your reps.

title: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down to at least parallel with your chest up.
Drive up explosively through your legs and use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top, lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders, and flow into the next squat.

title: Barbell Power Clean
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over your mid-foot. Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back and your chest up.
Push through the floor to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close to your shins.
When the bar passes your knees, extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on the front of your shoulders in a quarter squat, with your elbows high.
Stand up fully, then lower the bar under control back to your thighs and to the floor. Learn this with a coach and start light.

title: Bear Crawl
steps: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders, then lift your knees about 2-3 cm off the floor.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Move your opposite hand and foot forward together in small, controlled steps.
Keep your hips low and level and avoid swaying side to side.

title: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly in a running motion.
Keep your hips level, your shoulders over your hands, and your core braced.

title: Kettlebell Suitcase Carry
steps: Place a kettlebell beside your foot, hinge down to pick it up with one hand, and stand tall.
Hold it at your side without leaning toward it or away from it.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping your shoulders level and your ribs down.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back and repeat on the other side.

title: Dumbbell Renegade Row
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands on a pair of hex dumbbells shoulder-width apart and your feet wide for stability.
Brace your core and keep your hips square to the floor.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell under control and alternate sides without letting your hips rotate.
